card.name: Punctuation before a name or example
card.fires_on: Commas, periods and brackets that come right before a name or example is about to be listed. Seen after a surname in a citation, after Prague, CZ, and after e.g. in drug lists.

modes.label: Comma after surname
modes.description: A comma after a surname or first name in a citation, before the other name.

modes.label: After e.g. in drug lists
modes.description: The punctuation after e.g. or after a listed drug, just before the next drug name.

modes.label: Bracket after Prague
modes.description: An opening bracket after the city Prague, CZ, before the airport code.

card.writes: It seems to favor name-like pieces such as adam, ann and Karl, and to suppress other pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or bracket just before a name or example is given, such as a surname or a drug in an e.g. list.
